The adapter: pool and runtime-login checks, the tenant bind key, transaction statements and TENANT_PREAMBLE.
raw.src/infrastructure/postgres/stores/recor: The one typed wrapper per dynamic record function (plan section 1.5): app_record_ids, app_record_count and app_record_agg run clauses built from the record definitions, which Kysely cannot express as fixed-table queries.
raw.src/infrastructure/postgres/tenant-direc: Catalog checks on tables that are not engine tables: whether the pg_trgm extension is installed (pg_extension), and whether a managed index was left invalid (pg_index, pg_class, pg_namespace).
raw.src/infrastructure/postgres/query-compil: Builds dynamic record index expressions, the one owner of them; any query it gains stays raw.
raw.src/runtime/definitions/index-manager.ts: Managed-index DDL stays raw (run through the ManagedIndexes capability); its registry-row queries use Kysely.
raw.src/infrastructure/postgres/stores/owner: Calls the reviewed security-definer start-up function; the function result is not a generated table.
